name: Figellus
title: The Man of Apostasy from Asia
summary: Figellus was a Christian from the province of Asia who turned away from the apostle Paul during a difficult time. He is mentioned together with Hermogenes as examples of those who abandoned Paul when he needed support.

keyEvents.title: Turned Away from Paul
keyEvents.description: Figellus was among those in Asia who deserted Paul in his distress, a fact the apostle pointed out to Timothy as both a warning and a contrast to faithful service.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a Warning Example
keyEvents.description: By naming Figellus in his letter, Paul used him as an example of lacking perseverance and loyalty when facing persecution and hardship.
